purpose: Test whether residual topology failure in the mechanical mutex solver is caused by processing repulsive cannot-link evidence after attractive unions have already merged its endpoints.
causal_change_only: All repulsive constraints are installed on singleton vertices before any attractive union is allowed. Evidence masks, JSD ordering, holeless split and frozen closure thresholds remain unchanged.
teacher_policy: Every partition is frozen before teacher topology or teacher weights are loaded.

decision.pass: A variant closes all frozen topology gates and satisfies the solver invariant.
decision.causal_improvement: If closure remains open but mechanics improve materially with zero late repulsive edges, event ordering was a proven contributor.
decision.fail: No material improvement; residual owner lies elsewhere.
